# s385 — ai relay --json lists what each relay contract version changed

**Findings:** ork integration review 2026-10-19 (R5), noted on s378 · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** any change to a relay rule or a contract bump, versions before 5 (the code records no change text for them), and ork's own version list.

## Why

ork accepts a listed set of relay contract versions (ork integration review 2026-10-19, R5). To add a version on purpose, it needs to know what that version changed. Today that is recorded only as a code comment above `RELAY_CONTRACT` in `src/slicer/ai.py` (entries 5, 6 and 7). s378 put the rest of the machine-readable contract into `ai relay --json` and `ai relay-orchestrator --json` through `ai.relay_contract`; the change history is the part still missing. s382 moves the contract from v7 to v8, so this lands first and s382 adds its own entry.
